content:
Hi everyone! I knew Lean 4 and Mathlib in this year early, and I'm interested in the formalization of wavelet analysis. From my search result, now the section of wavelet analysis hasn't been formalized in mathlib, I want to push the program up, so I create this topic and have some questions which need to discuss the people who intersted in the program.

I have sent emails to Daniel Smania, whose project covers unbalanced Haar wavelets on measure spaces. In the discussion with Smania, I confirmed that our scopes don't overlap.

Now the program is on planning, so I want to know that has anyone seen existing work or similar plans in this direction that I might have missed? Another question is that would a general theory of Hilbert-space frames be a proper addition to mathlib, which I think is not only useful on wavelets analysis, but also in many other theories.

I'm glad to discuss this program with everyone who is interested in it, thanks!
